items.title: How TokenForge Activated Authentic RWA Market Narratives Without Upfront Influencer Spend
items.summary_short: TokenForge ditched traditional influencer deals and their $10K+ price tags. Instead, they chose Zealy's performance-based campaigns with 10x ROI. Generating dozens of posts about RWA tokenization, paying only for content that met real engagement benchmarks.
